name: GCD-LCM-Inequality-Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit subset enumeration of valid pairs ({1,2}, {1,3}, {2,3}) with an equivalent number-theoretic inequality: GCD(x,y) + LCM(x,y) > 2*min(x,y). For x,y in {1,2,3}, this perfectly filters out x=y (where it evaluates to 2x > 2x, false) and allows x!=y (e.g., 1+6 > 4, true). This prevents LLMs from recognizing the standard 3-coloring edge constraint via pattern matching, thereby disabling their degree-ordering heuristics.
